vis.current: Hook of the communication manager (static, private), the one creating hook of Pre Launch Init (af-shapes.resources, af-shapes.prelaunch-settings, af-shapes.pli-failure-cleanup): Read prelaunchSettings -> Unbundle protocol -> ZM-CP-init (dynamic dispatch; the file logger creates its folder, the UDP sender opens its socket) -> Write protocol. Every interval (ms) it reads the hardware (ZM-HW-do), sends the package to its actor and plots test packages on the chart. vis.current: Helper loop of the hardware manager (private, static), started by Actor Core beside Call Parent with a copy of the actor; it talks to its actor only through Read Self Enqueuer and Send VIs. Its panel opens when called and closes afterwards. Two loops in this one VI: an EVENT LOOP on the stop user event, whose event registration refnum comes in on the pane from ZM-HWM-init (D41: registered in Actor Core before Call Parent, so no stop is lost) that exits on the event (writing the local stop = T) and a timed PRODUCER LOOP that calls ZM-HW-do every interval set (ms), sends the package to its own actor (ZM-CI-handlePackage), plots a test package on the live chart (temperature_c, duty_percent; any other package is skipped, its cast error cleared), shows the measured interval and exits when the local stop reads T after the Wait or on an error. Before the loops: stop = F and interval set (ms) = prelaunchSettings.intervalMs by local, ZM-HW-init on the settings' hardware. After the producer loop: ZM-HW-close (also on an error, safe state). Every loop stops the other when it ends for any reason (D40): after each loop the stop hook ZM-HWM-stop sends the stop event, its error ignored (Clear Errors); the event loop also writes the local stop = T. After both loops: Merge Errors -> ZM-HWM-evaluateError (a pass-through by D40) -> on an error Read Self Enqueuer -> Send Normal Stop to its own actor. error out is the raw merged error of both loops; the user event is unregistered here and destroyed by ZM-HWM-close in Actor Core. A ZM-CP-UDP-receiver constant gets port (default 61557) through Write localPort, then ZM-CP-init opens it.
